newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander shares shoot up on Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Santander shares shoot up on Q1 results.

text.p: Shares in Banco Santander shot higher to outperform the market on Tuesday, bolstered by a better-than-expected first quarter result, dealers said.
"These are better than expected, with a strong performance at the operating level," said a dealer at Central Hispano Bolsa.
Earlier, Santander announced a rise of 23.7 percent in first quarter attributable profit to 24.8 billion pesetas, with operating profit to 60.36 billion pesetas from 41.31 billion pesetas.
In a Reuters poll, analysts had forecast a 21 percent rise in attributable profit, and operating income in the region of 53.50 billion pesetas, versus the reported figure of 60.36 billion.
At 1040 GMT, Santander shares had added 260 pesetas to 10,570 pesetas. At the same time the Ibex-35 was gaining 0.43 percent to 5,781.41.

"Santander shares are gaining before the announcement, they're boosted by the results. But it's still too early to make detailed comments...we're looking at the results' breakdown," said Fadi Ismail, a trader at Credit Lyonnais in Madrid.
He added that the market was targeting a rise of Santander shares to 11,200 pesetas.
